alt: An annotated screenshot of the CDSS ACMS portal showing Case SHN-105273296 against L.A. Care, highlighting regulatory violations of 42 CFR Section 431.244(f)(1) and CDSS MPP Section 22-060.1 due to the June 15, 2026, statutory deadline being missed.
full_text: VIOLATION: The Federal Regulation: 42 CFR Section 431.244(f)(1). VIOLATION: The California State Regulation: CDSS MPP (Manual of Policies and Procedures) Section 22-060.1. Case SHN-105273296 remains PENDING SCHEDULING past its Due Date of 06/15/2026.
summary: Annotated screenshot of the CDSS ACMS portal for Case SHN-105273296. The annotations explicitly cite federal regulation 42 CFR Section 431.244(f)(1) and California state regulation CDSS MPP Section 22-060.1 as having been directly violated by the agency's failure to schedule or decide the State Hearing request by its mandatory June 15, 2026, deadline.
